description:
The "Witchcrafter" guild is a magical crafts workshop based in a coastal port town.
Its master, "Witchcrafter Madame Verre", has little interest in work, preferring instead to spend her days enjoying an easy, carefree life.
Meanwhile, the town is in a flurry of activity as preparations begin for its annual festival.
Amid all the bustle, "Schmietta", one of the guild`s members, ends up bringing back a rather serious problem.
Source: Official English Website

titles.title: マギストスIII「ウィッチクラフトマスター・ヴェール」
